proposed_reports.title: Rôles d'évaluation foncière de l'agglomération de Montréal (triennal)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ville de Montréal (Direction de l'évaluation foncière)
proposed_reports.description: Triennial real-estate assessment rolls for the 16 municipalities of the Montreal agglomeration. Deposited every three years (most recent 2026-2027-2028 deposited September 2025), they inventory every immovable, its characteristics and its real value as of the statutory valuation date (1 July of the year preceding the first year of the roll). Form the legal base for municipal and school property taxes and for the calculation of richesse foncière uniformisée.

proposed_reports.title: Règlement sur l'imposition des taxes et des compensations (Ville de Québec)
proposed_reports.description: Annual by-law (most recent R.V.Q. 3492 for fiscal year 2026) that sets the general property-tax rates by property category, water/sewer and residual-materials tariffs, and other compensations for the City of Quebec. Applied to the values on the current assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: Fonds des générations (revenus consacrés et solde)
proposed_reports.description: Statutory dedicated fund whose revenues (water-power royalties, additional Hydro-Québec contribution, investment income, and occasional transfers from other funds) are used exclusively for debt repayment. The annual dedicated revenues and fund balance are reported in the Plan budgétaire and are excluded from the budgetary balance under the Loi sur l'équilibre budgétaire.

proposed_reports.title: Projections démographiques du Québec et de ses régions
proposed_reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
proposed_reports.description: Annual update of population projections for Quebec and its administrative regions (and selected CMAs) under multiple scenarios. Incorporates the latest fertility, mortality and migration assumptions; used for medium- and long-term planning and as context for the Bilan démographique and economic forecasts.

proposed_reports.title: Proportions médianes des rôles et facteurs comparatifs
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
proposed_reports.description: Annual publication of the median proportion of each municipal assessment roll relative to market and the resulting comparative factors used to uniformize assessed values for the calculation of richesse foncière uniformisée and other fiscal applications.

dependencies.basis: Property-tax rates published for a given year are applied to the assessed values appearing on the current triennial assessment roll (after any statutory phasing of value changes).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Le rôle d’évaluation sert de base au calcul des taxes municipales et scolaires.

dependencies.basis: The RFU for Montreal-area municipalities is computed directly from the values inscribed on the agglomeration's triennial assessment rolls, multiplied by the applicable comparative factor.
dependencies.evidence_quote: La RFU d’une municipalité comprend l’évaluation uniformisée de tous les immeubles imposables situés sur son territoire... Les évaluations sont uniformisées en les multipliant par le facteur comparatif

dependencies.basis: The annual tax-and-compensation by-law implements the taxation decisions contained in the City's adopted operating budget for that fiscal year.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Ce règlement prévoit l’imposition des taxes et des compensations pour l’exercice financier de 2026.

dependencies.basis: The Plan budgétaire reports the dedicated revenues deposited into the Generations Fund and the resulting budgetary balance after those deposits; the Fund's statutory revenues and balance are therefore a direct input to the fiscal framework presented in the budget.
dependencies.evidence_quote: En 2025‑2026 et en 2026‑2027, les revenus consacrés au Fonds des générations s’établiront respectivement à 2,5 milliards de dollars et à 2,4 milliards de dollars.

dependencies.basis: The Balanced Budget Act explicitly excludes revenues and expenditures recorded in the Generations Fund from the statutory budgetary balance and requires the Fund's dedicated revenues to be used solely for debt reduction.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Il ne comprend pas: 1 ° les revenus et les dépenses comptabilisés au Fonds des générations institué par la Loi sur la réduction de la dette et instituant le Fonds des générations

dependencies.basis: One of the three components of the Indice de vitalité économique is the five-year average annual population growth rate (TAAM), which is taken from the official population estimates underlying the Bilan démographique and related ISQ demographic products.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources : Institut de la statistique du Québec, exploitation des données fiscales des particuliers de Revenu Québec et Estimations démographiques annuelles.

dependencies.basis: The population-growth component of the IVE draws on the annual demographic estimates produced jointly by Statistics Canada and ISQ.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Statistique Canada, Estimations démographiques annuelles (régions infraprovinciales, mai 2024).

dependencies.basis: Uniformization of assessed values for RFU purposes is performed by multiplying the values on each municipal roll by the comparative factor derived from that roll's median proportion relative to market.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Les évaluations sont uniformisées en les multipliant par le facteur comparatif approuvé par la ou le ministre des Affaires municipales pour l’année en cours.

dependencies.basis: The annual population-projection update incorporates the latest observed fertility, mortality and migration components published in the Bilan démographique and related demographic estimates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The new projections take into account the most recent data on migration, fertility and mortality.
